title: The café doesn't get your $4.75 #shorts
description:
Pay $4.75 by credit card and three companies take a slice before the café sees it. Average US credit interchange is about 1.9% (NBER, Jul 2026); ≈10-15¢ on a $4.75 coffee is our estimate.

The whole two seconds, from the tap to the night the money moves: https://www.youtube.com/@zerounderstands

#shorts #howitworks #creditcards
